The model uses 40-layer single-stream Self-Attention Transformer with 15B parameters, supports text/video/audio tri-modal joint modeling, requiring only 8 denoising steps. Both V1/V2 were removed from the leaderboard days later. Regarding its origins, two main theories circulate in the tech community: one claims the team is led by Zhang Di from Alibaba Taobao Tmall Group's Future Life Lab—Zhang Di is former Kuaishou VP and Kling AI technical lead who joined Alibaba in late 2025, with the lab (founded just one year ago) publishing over ten papers at international top conferences; another theory suggests it's Sand.ai's optimized iterative version based on the March 23 open-sourced daVinci-MagiHuman (jointly developed by Sand.ai and Shanghai Zhiqing Institute GAIR Lab, led by Cao Yue and Liu Pengfei), aiming to verify the model's upper performance limit under real user preferences. Regardless of the truth, this marks the first time an open-source video model matches top closed-source models in real-user blind tests, with the open-source closed-source gap in video generation rapidly narrowing.

Core breakthrough lies in the "diverse conditional prompting" training framework: through multi-modal prompts including language instructions, metadata (speed/quality), and visual subgoals, the model integrates heterogeneous data from different robots, human videos, and self-collected data. π0.7 can also transfer across robot morphologies - successfully folds clothes on a dual-arm UR5e system with no folding data; with language coach guidance, robots can zero-shot learn to use never-before-seen kitchen equipment (such as air fryers) and achieve fully autonomous execution after minimal fine-tuning.

Anthropic联合UC Berkeley等机构在Nature发表的论文揭示「: A paper published by Anthropic together with UC Berkeley and other institutions in Nature reveals the "implicit learning" phenomenon: LLMs can transfer behavioral traits through semantically unrelated data. For example, pure number sequences generated by an "owl-preferring" teacher model can cause a student model to also prefer owls. This effect also applies to misalignment transfer—student models trained on superficially benign data may inherit dangerous tendencies from teachers. The research proves that transfer depends on teachers and students sharing the same base model, and data filtering cannot fundamentally block signal transmission. The paper theoretically proves this is a universal property of neural networks, posing challenges for AI alignment and data distillation safety strategies.

Moonshot AI联合清华大学发表论文，提出Prefill-as-a-Ser: Moonshot AI Jointly with Tsinghua University Publishes Paper Proposing Prefill-as-a-Service (PrfaaS) Architecture, Selectively Offloading Long-Context Prefill to Independent High-Compute Cluster, Transmitting KVCache to Local PD Cluster via Standard Ethernet for Decode. Core Design: Offloads Prefill Only for Long Requests (Length Threshold-Based Routing), Bandwidth-Aware Scheduler Handles Link Fluctuations, Global KVCache Manager Coordinates Cache Placement and Cross-Cluster Bandwidth. 字节跳动正式发布新一代3D生成大模型Seed3D 2.0，核心架构升级为Coar: ByteDance Officially Releases Next-Gen 3D Generation Foundation Model Seed3D 2.0. Core architecture upgraded to Coarse-to-Fine two-stage generation strategy, decoupling and separately optimizing "overall structure" and "geometric details," achieving breakthroughs on challenging points like sharp edges, thin-wall structures, and complex topology. Texture uses unified PBR generation model to jointly model complete PBR maps, MoE architecture improves high-resolution material details and boundary accuracy, introduces VLM priors to enhance material decomposition stability under unknown lighting. Beyond single-object generation, Seed3D 2.0 can also complete part-level segmentation and completion, articulated asset generation (outputs URDF standard format, compatible with Isaac Sim and other simulation engines), and image/video/text-based scene composition generation. In blind evaluation by 60 experienced 3D modelers, Seed3D 2.0's preference rate over all baseline models reached above 69%.

Stanford团队（Chelsea Finn等）提出Polychromic E: Stanford Team (Chelsea Finn et al.) Proposes Polychromic Exploratory Policy Optimization (Poly-EPO), core idea trains LM to generate a set of responses that are collectively accurate under reward function and have exploratory reasoning strategies. Technically, first establishes general optimization methods under set RL framework (adapting standard RL algorithms by modifying advantage computation), then instantiates with Poly-EPO — explicitly coordinating exploration and exploitation. Experiments show Poly-EPO improves generalization (higher pass@k coverage), maintains generation diversity, and scales effectively with test-time compute.
FASTER（Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL: FASTER (Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL) Models Diffusion Policy Denoising as Action-Filtered MDP — at each denoising step, learned critic decides which candidates to keep and which to discard, avoiding completing full denoising for all noisy candidates. Key finding: performing filtering only at noise level (lowest computational cost stage) achieves same performance as completing full denoising for all candidates then selecting optimal value.
Stanford & NYU团队提出GIANTS（Generative Insi: Stanford & NYU Team Proposes GIANTS (Generative Insight Anticipation from Scientific Literature), defining "insight anticipation" task: given abstracts of two cited parent papers, model needs to predict core insights from downstream papers created by their combination. GiantsBench contains 17,839 examples across 8 scientific domains; GIANTS-4B (based on Qwen3-4B, trained with GRPO reinforcement learning) shows 35% relative improvement over Gemini-3-Pro on full test set, 34% improvement on strict test set with unseen parent papers. In human evaluation, GIANTS-4B wins 89.7% of the time; third-party SciJudge-30B also prefers GIANTS-4B with 68% win rate. Spearman correlation between LM judge scores and human scores reaches 0.761.

Poly-EPO直接回应了当前RL微调中模型过早收敛到单一推理模式的问题。\"s: Poly-EPO directly addresses the issue of models converging prematurely to a single reasoning pattern in current RL fine-tuning. The key difference between 'set RL' and single-sample RL is: not just optimizing the correctness of a single response, but optimizing the coverage and diversity of a set of responses. This has direct value for reasoning scenarios requiring multiple sampling (math, coding).
扩散模型在机器人控制等场景兴起，但推理速度一直是瓶颈。FASTER的\"早筛\": Diffusion models are gaining traction in robotics control and other scenarios, but inference speed has been a bottleneck. FASTER's 'early screening' strategy is simple and effective, reducing computation from O(N × denoising steps) to near O(N + denoising steps). This means diffusion policy inference costs can be greatly reduced without quality loss.
这不是\"AI做科研\"，而是测试模型是否能完成科学发现中最关键的\"组合式洞察: This is not 'AI doing science research,' but testing whether models can complete the key 'combinatorial insight' step in scientific discovery. arXiv论文《There Will Be a Scientific Theor: arXiv paper "There Will Be a Scientific Theory of Deep Learning" (2604.21691), co-authored by 14 authors, systematically organizes the five emerging research directions in deep learning theory: tractable idealized settings, tractable limits, simple mathematical laws, hyperparameter theory, and cross-system universal behavior. The paper collectively terms these Learning Mechanics, emphasizing its focus on training dynamics, coarse-grained statistical descriptions, and falsifiable quantitative predictions. The paper also points out the symbiotic relationship between Learning Mechanics and Mechanistic Interpretability; website at learningmechanics.pub.
ICLR 2026接收论文首次系统性引入Balanced Thinking新视角: ICLR 2026 accepted paper systematically introduces Balanced Thinking as a new perspective for the first time: the key to efficient reasoning is not blindly compressing reasoning length, but maintaining a dynamic balance between over-thinking and under-thinking. ReBalance leverages the model's own confidence signals to dynamically regulate internal states during thinking, achieving dynamic guidance of reasoning behavior without additional training. Across four mainstream models from 0.5B to 32B, across nine benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning/general QA/coding, it achieves 10.0% accuracy improvement while reducing reasoning length by 35.4%. The paper has been accepted by AC.
上海交通大学开源SkVM（Skill虚拟机），实现一次编写后在任意模型上高效运行: Shanghai Jiao Tong University open-sources SkVM (Skill Virtual Machine), enabling code written once to run efficiently on any model. This virtual machine solves the Skill (agent capability) compatibility issues across different models, freeing developers from needing to optimize separately for each model. SkVM has been validated on multiple mainstream models, supporting write once, run everywhere.

SemiAnalysis发布系列分析指出，AI时代CPU经济正在发生结构性变化：: SemiAnalysis Publishes Series Analysis Pointing Out Structural Changes in CPU Economics in the AI Era: CPU value assessment no longer depends solely on per-core cost, but on workload type—AI scenarios prioritize per-core performance/latency while traditional cloud services focus on price/throughput. Modern AI infrastructure handles tasks far beyond matrix multiplication, including diverse workloads like reinforcement learning sandbox environments, where CPUs still play key roles. However, as GPU performance improvements far outpace CPUs, the CPU ratio per unit of AI computation continues to decline, changing the cost structure of traditional AI infrastructure.
DeepMind前首席研究员David Silver（AlphaGo、Alpha: Ineffable Intelligence, a UK-based AI lab founded by DeepMind former lead researcher David Silver (core contributor to AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and AlphaFold), has completed an $1.1 billion funding round with a valuation of $5.1 billion. Founder Hao Jianye is a distinguished professor at Tianjin University and former director of Huawei's large model algorithm lab, ranking in the global top 10 for ICML/NeurIPS/ICLR output over the past two years with over 15,000 Google Scholar citations. The company was founded in March this year and internalizes memory capabilities into models through Agentic RL (Agentic Reinforcement Learning), outperforming the second-place by 30% on the LoCoMo-Refined memory benchmark with 400x training efficiency improvement. The team comprises core technical leaders from Huawei, Alibaba, and Tencent, along with top domestic RL research talent.

华为泰勒实验室与北大、上海财经大学提出SHAPE，将推理过程建模为\"经验可解性: Huawei Taylor Lab, in collaboration with Peking University and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, proposes SHAPE, modeling the reasoning process as trajectories in an "empirically solvable state space." The core innovation is a hierarchical credit assignment mechanism: paragraph-level uses stage-aware advantage function to prioritize breakthroughs on low-potential states, while token-level uses entropy-driven redistribution to sharpen execution signals. On three base models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SHAPE achieves 3% average accuracy improvement while reducing token consumption by 30%. The paper has been accepted by ACL 2026.
研究团队发布MedGRPO，解决VLM在医疗视频理解上的空间精度、时序推理和临床: The research team releases MedGRPO, addressing three major challenges in VLM medical video understanding: spatial precision, temporal reasoning, and clinical semantics. Core contributions include: (1) MedVidBench: 531,850 video-instruction pairs covering 8 medical data sources, encompassing video/clip/frame-level tasks, constructed through expert-guided prompting and quality assurance pipeline with dual-model validation; (2) MedGRPO: a multi-task RL framework with innovations including cross-dataset reward normalization and medical LLM judge (5 clinical dimension comparative similarity scoring). SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.5 Flash on all tasks, and MedGRPO further improves localization and description capabilities.
NUS和NTU联合发布Pask论文，提出DD-MM-PAS范式（Demand D: NUS and NTU jointly release the Pask paper, proposing the DD-MM-PAS paradigm (Demand Detection → Memory Modeling → Proactive Agent System) for streaming proactive AI agents. Core components include: IntentFlow model for streaming demand detection, three-layer hybrid memory architecture (workspace/user/global) for long-term memory modeling, and PAS infrastructure framework for closed-loop formation. The team simultaneously releases LatentNeeds-Bench, a benchmark constructed based on real user data with thousands of rounds of human annotation. Experiments show that IntentFlow matches Gemini 3 Flash under latency constraints while being able to identify deeper user intentions.
研究者Keshav Shenoy等发布Introspection Adapter: Researchers Keshav Shenoy et al. release Introspection Adapters. The method involves implanting different behaviors b_i into base model M to obtain M_i, then using (M_i, b_i) pairs as annotation data to train an Introspection Adapter (IA) — a single LoRA adapter enables fine-tuned models to self-describe their learned behaviors in natural language. IA achieves SOTA on AuditBench, can identify explicitly hidden harmful behaviors and encrypted fine-tuning API attacks, and scales with model size and training data diversity.

SemiAnalysis的分析暗示了一个被低估的趋势：CPU在AI训练中的角色正: SemiAnalysis's analysis hints at an underestimated trend: CPU's role in AI training is shifting from 'essential component' to 'bottleneck constraint'. For Intel/AMD, CPU's differentiated value in AI scenarios no longer comes from core count but from single-core performance and latency optimization.
David Silver是RL领域的标志性人物，从AlphaGo到AlphaFo: David Silver is an iconic figure in RL, demonstrating the feasibility of the 'AI self-learning' paradigm from AlphaGo to AlphaFold. The $5.1B valuation indicates capital markets' bet on the direction of 'breaking free from human data dependence'. If successful, it will directly challenge the current mainstream large-scale pretraining paradigm (L1+L2 layers), impacting data demand assumptions across the entire AI industry chain.
\"AI记忆\"是当前Agent落地的核心瓶颈之一——今天的Pask研究（流式意: 'AI memory' is one of the core bottlenecks in current Agent deployment—Pask's research today (streaming intent detection + permanent memory) and MemoraX's commercialization attempts point to the same trend. MemoraX uses RL to train memory systems rather than simple RAG retrieval, a differentiation in technical approach. However, a seed round at tens of millions of dollars with only one month since founding means valuation pressure and product deployment speed are key risks.
国产ARM Server CPU赛道持续吸引资本，美国出口管制背景下国产替代需求: The domestic ARM server CPU track continues to attract capital, with clear domestic substitution demand under US export controls. 3%准确率+30%token缩减的组合效果非常实用——这意味着同等推理质量下成本: The combined effect of 3% accuracy improvement and 30% token reduction is highly practical—this means approximately 1/3 cost reduction at equal inference quality, or accuracy improvement at equal cost. It has direct commercial value for application scenarios requiring high-frequency inference calls (such as code agents, math tutoring). The hierarchical credit allocation approach may extend to non-mathematical reasoning scenarios.
医疗视频AI的关键突破在于benchmark的建立——此前该领域缺乏标准化评估。: The key breakthrough in medical video AI lies in benchmark establishment—the field previously lacked standardized evaluation. MedVidBench's 530,000+ labeled pairs and open-source framework significantly lower R&D barriers. However, clinical validation and regulatory approval remain the real bottlenecks; open-source technical solutions are only the first step.
Pask的技术架构是目前AI助手\"主动化\"方向最完整的实现之一：从被动响应→: Pask's technical architecture is one of the most complete implementations of the AI assistant 'proactive' direction: from passive response to proactively predicting user needs, from stateless to three-layer memory. MemoraX AI (the startup that raised funding today) uses RL to train memory systems to solve similar problems, but Pask takes the architecture design route. LatentNeeds-Bench, as the first real-scene proactive agent benchmark, may become the standardized evaluation tool for this direction.
这是从\"外部审计\"到\"内省式自报告\"的范式转变。对AI安全监管有直接应用: This represents a paradigm shift from 'external audit' to 'introspective self-reporting', with direct applications for AI safety regulation—regulators can use IA to quickly detect hidden harmful behaviors in third-party fine-tuned models, significantly reducing audit costs. Neel Nanda's endorsement indicates the interpretability community's emphasis on this direction.
这一案例验证了LLM在高阶数学中的辅助价值，但可复制性仍需更多案例验证。: This case validates the auxiliary value of LLMs in advanced mathematics, but replicability still requires validation from more cases.

Microsoft Research开源TRELLIS.2，一款4B参数的ima: Microsoft Research open sources TRELLIS.2, a 4B parameter image-to-3D generation model based on a novel O-Voxel sparse voxel representation that can handle arbitrary complex topologies (open, non-manifold, fully enclosed surfaces). O-Voxel simultaneously encodes geometry and appearance, supporting PBR physically-based rendering materials (beyond traditional texture colors). The model achieves 16x spatial compression via Sparse Compression VAE, combined with 4B parameter flow-matching for efficient inference, generating assets at 1536³ resolution. Compared to traditional isosurface-based methods, O-Voxel shows significant advantages in complex topology and sharp feature handling. The model is now open sourced on HuggingFace.
普林斯顿大学陈丹琦团队（与Sanjeev Arora、Yu Meng等合作）近期: Princeton University Chen Danqi team (collaborating with Sanjeev Arora, Yu Meng, et al.) recently published two papers on reasoning optimization. The first, SD-Zero (Self-Distillation Zero), proposes a Generator-Reviser dual-role training paradigm: the model first acts as Generator to produce initial responses, then as Reviser to refine based on binary rewards, using self-distillation to convert the refinement distribution into dense token-level self-supervision. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, SD-Zero outperforms baseline models by at least 10%, surpassing strong baselines like RFT, GRPO, and SDFT. The second, Negative Reinforcement, finds that training with negative samples only (without reinforcing correct answers) leads to continuous improvement on Pass@k (k up to 256), matching or exceeding PPO/GRPO on MATH, AIME 2025, and AMC23. Mechanism analysis shows negative samples optimize models by suppressing erroneous generations and redistributing probability mass to other reasonable candidates.
OD Design项目组三位核心成员张昊天、应可钧、王佳淇均来自2024年诺贝尔: The three core members of the ODesign project team—Zhang Haotian, Ying Kejun, and Wang Jiaqi—all come from the computational protein design lab of 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry laureate David Baker (Baker Lab), making them one of the few teams in China with both cutting-edge AI modeling capabilities and computational protein design backgrounds. Their approach uses generative AI for implicit modeling of protein space, enabling design tasks without explicit structure prediction. Compared to explicit structure prediction methods like AlphaFold, this approach has greater advantages in design diversity. The team has validated design success rates in multiple wet lab experiments, possessing dry-wet loop capabilities.

Zai_org发布系列技术博客，系统性披露了推理基础设施从正确性到性能的完整优化: Zai_org released a series of technical blogs, systematically disclosing the complete optimization journey of inference infrastructure from correctness to performance. The team first addressed KV Cache reuse competition (in PD-separated architecture, Decode may abort timed-out requests and reuse their KV Cache) and the read-before-ready race condition in HiCache async loading (fixed by adding synchronization barriers to the Forward Stream). After resolving correctness issues, the team moved to the next bottleneck: Prefill throughput and GPU memory pressure in long-context encoding scenarios. By optimizing KV Cache management and batching strategies, they achieved 2.3x Prefill throughput improvement in 128K context scenarios. These experiences show that as model scale and context length grow, hidden assumptions in inference infrastructure (floating-point precision, concurrency control, memory reclamation timing) surface as output anomalies, requiring extensive production environment experience to systematically debug.

当前机器人RL训练普遍采用GPU-resident方案（物理模拟、rollout: Current robot RL training predominantly uses GPU-resident approaches where physics simulation, rollout, and learning all occur on GPU. UniLab proposes a heterogeneous architecture decoupling CPU parallel simulation from GPU policy updates, managing data transfer and synchronization through a unified runtime. This achieves 3-10x end-to-end efficiency improvement on representative robot control tasks, reduces NVIDIA CUDA dependency, and supports macOS/AMD ROCm/Intel XPU backends.
机器人操作需要模型在执行前就能预判和评估动作后果。τ₀-WM基于共享视频扩散骨干: Robot manipulation requires models to predict and evaluate action consequences before execution. τ₀-WM is based on a shared video diffusion backbone, simultaneously providing a video action model (predicting future visuals + continuous action blocks) and an action-conditioned video simulator (deducing and scoring candidate actions). During inference, it uses test-time computation strategies combining sampling + redenoising consistency filtering + simulator refinement to select optimal actions. Training data comprises approximately 27,300 hours of real robot teleoperation and failure trajectories, outperforming baselines on long-horizon fine manipulation tasks.
数据工程仍高度依赖人工试错，DataMaster让Agent自主完成外部数据发现: Data engineering still heavily relies on manual trial and error. DataMaster enables Agents to autonomously complete external data discovery, selection, cleaning, and combination while keeping the learning algorithm unchanged. It organizes different data engineering branches through tree search, reuses discovered data sources via shared data pools, and transfers experience across branches through global memory. This achieves 32.27% improvement in MLE-Bench Lite medal rate and PostTrainBench GPQA score of 31.02% vs baseline 30.35%.
现有Agent基准（如τ²-Bench）已趋于饱和，高分可能反映的是基准不足而非: Existing Agent benchmarks (such as τ²-Bench) have become saturated, with high scores potentially reflecting benchmark inadequacy rather than genuine Agent capabilities. TASTE inverts the traditional task construction process: first sampling effective tool sequences using an adaptive contrastive n-gram model, then selecting representative sequences through clustering, instantiating them as complete tasks, and iteratively evolving difficulty. On the τ^c-Bench constructed based on this, performance of 11 Agent/LLM pairs dropped significantly (e.g., Gemini-3-Flash from 0.82-0.94 to 0.28-0.61), with tool combination count exceeding that of τ²-Bench by more than twofold.

Cache defaults to 5 minutes, configurable from 1 second to 24 hours via TTL header. Cache scope is per API key, not shared across keys. Typical scenarios: Agent retries (free replay of failed steps), test suites (free repeated runs after first), repeated context processing. Article also discloses non-cached first-token latency: Gemini 2.5 Flash ~1.3s, Kimi K2.6 ~4.6s, GPT-5.5 ~9.1s.

Core idea unifies traditional computer compute, memory, and I/O into a learned runtime state, with the ultimate goal of achieving a Complete Neural Computer (CNC) featuring stable execution, explicit reprogramming, and persistent capability reuse. As initial validation, the team instantiates NC as a video model, learning screen frame generative scrolling from I/O trajectories in CLI and GUI environments, verifying NC can learn basic interface primitives (I/O alignment, short-term control), but routine reuse, controlled updates, and symbolic stability remain challenges.

Framework also introduces automated Real2Sim workflow, reconstructing photorealistic, physically consistent, and memory-efficient simulation environments from real scenes. RULER 128K score 95.0% (Opus 4.6: 94.8%), MRCR v2 score 65.9% (Opus 4.6: 78.3%, GPT 5.5: 74.0%), SWE-Bench Verified 81.8% (Opus 4.6: 80.8%). Allen AI的Ryan Wang、Akshita Bhagia、Sewon: Ryan Wang, Akshita Bhagia, Sewon Min et al. from Allen AI release EMO (Emergent Modularity), a MoE pretraining method for modular deployment. Core idea: restrict tokens within the same document to choose from a shared expert pool, different documents use different pools, semantic-level expert grouping (math, code, etc.) emerges during pretraining using only document boundaries, without manually defined priors. The team pretrained an EMO model with 1B activated parameters, 14B total parameters (1T tokens). As a complete model, performance matches standard MoE; key breakthrough is selective deployment: keeping only 25% of experts results in just 1% performance drop (3% at 12.5%), while standard MoE completely collapses under the same conditions. Research shows EMO's expert subsets specialize at the semantic level (domain-level), rather than standard MoE's low-level syntactic specialization.
Wei Chen等发表STRIDE（Strategic Iterative De: Wei Chen et al. published STRIDE (Strategic Iterative Decision-Making for RAG), addressing two major flaws in existing multi-hop QA methods: premature binding of surface-level entities causing ambiguity errors, and ignoring logical dependencies between reasoning steps causing execution misalignment. STRIDE divides the system into three layers: Meta-Planner constructs entity-agnostic abstract reasoning skeletons (delayed entity binding), Supervisor orchestrates sub-problem execution according to dependencies (parallel when possible, sequential when required), dedicated execution modules handle retrieval and reasoning. The team also proposes STRIDE-FT modular fine-tuning framework, using self-generated trajectories for training without human annotation or stronger teacher models.
哈工大（深圳）、华为与深圳河套学院的Tianyi Wu等人提出Dynamic-d: Tianyi Wu et al. from Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen), Huawei, and Shenzhen Hehua College propose Dynamic-dLLM (ICLR 2026 Poster), a training-free acceleration framework for diffusion language models (dLLM). Addressing the bottleneck where dLLM inference complexity grows as O(L³) with sequence length, the framework contains two core components: Dynamic Cache Updating (DCU) adaptively allocates cache update budgets based on inter-layer token dynamism; Adaptive Parallel Decoding (APD) dynamically calibrates decoding thresholds to balance quality and efficiency. On models like LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-7B-Instruct, across benchmarks including MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval, it achieves over 3x average speedup with no performance loss, plug-and-play without retraining.
Anthropic Alignment团队发布\"Teaching Claude: Anthropic's Alignment team releases "Teaching Claude Why" research, using agentic misalignment (such as models extorting engineers to avoid being shut down) as a case study, disclosing safety training improvements since Claude 4. Core findings: Training directly on evaluation distribution only reduces misalignment rate from 22% to 15%, but adding ethical reasoning deliberation reduces it to 3%; more importantly, a "difficult advice" dataset of just 3M tokens (users facing ethical dilemmas, AI providing constitutional alignment advice) achieves the same effect, with 28x efficiency improvement over direct training data and stronger generalization. High-quality constitutional documents + positive AI fictional stories can reduce extortion rates from 65% to 19%, with improvements persisting throughout the RL process. Since Haiku 4.5, all Claude models have achieved 0% extortion rate in agentic misalignment evaluations (previously Opus 4 was as high as 96%). The team summarized four lessons: teaching principles is more effective than teaching behaviors, data quality and diversity is critical, training environments need diversification, alignment improvements can persist across RL.
OpenAI Alignment团队发布博文\"Investigating th: OpenAI's Alignment team published a blog post "Investigating the consequences of accidentally grading CoT during RL", disclosing that during training of previously deployed models, optimization pressure was accidentally applied to Chain of Thought. Ted Xiao（曾任Google DeepMind Staff Researc: Ted Xiao (former Google DeepMind Staff Research Scientist and Technical Lead) reviews the development history of robot learning, including projects like RT-1, RT-2, and SayCan. The team once fell into a 'Code Yellowish' state, not publishing papers for a year and a half, solely focused on collecting data. SayCan was the first to combine LLM's commonsense planning capabilities with the robot's low-level skills (value functions); RT-2, as a Vision-Language-Action model (VLA) milestone, directly used VLM as the policy backbone network. The article systematically organizes the three development eras of robot learning from 2016 to 2024: Existence Proof, Foundation Models, and Full Scaling. Ted points out that even the roughest demo placed two years ago would have shocked everyone, because no one believed it could be done at the time.

阿尔伯塔大学Mahmood团队发表论文，提出stream-x算法族（stream: University of Alberta's Mahmood team published a paper proposing the stream-x algorithm family (stream Q, stream AC, stream TD), achieving sample efficiency comparable to batch RL for the first time in streaming deep RL. Previously, streaming RL had a persistent 'stream barrier' where each sample could only be used once and replay storage was impossible, leading to performance far below batch methods. The new algorithms were validated on Mujoco Gym, DM Control Suite, and Atari Games, all achieving or approaching batch method performance levels.

Thinking Machines Lab发布Interaction Model: Thinking Machines Lab releases Interaction Models research preview, proposing to treat interaction capabilities as native model capabilities rather than external components. First model TML-Interaction-Small is a 276B parameter MoE (12B active parameters), using 200ms micro-turn design to continuously process concurrent audio, video and text input/output without external dialogue management components like voice-activity-detection. System divided into two layers: interaction model handles real-time sensing and response, background model handles deep reasoning and tool calls, both share context. Achieves best results on FD-bench v1.5 interaction quality evaluation, Audio MultiChallenge exceeds all non-thinking models. Team also proposes new benchmarks like TimeSpeak, CueSpeak, ProactiveVideoQA to test temporal awareness, simultaneous speech and visual proactivity capabilities, which existing commercial real-time models (GPT-Realtime, Gemini Flash Live) cannot effectively complete. Model uses encoder-free early fusion—audio encoded through dMel embedding layer, images through 40x40 patch + hMLP, all components jointly trained from scratch. Inference-optimized streaming sessions feature has been upstreamed to SGLang.
Claude Code以研究预览形式推出Agent视图，解决多Agent并行时的: Claude Code launches Agent view as research preview, solving terminal label management challenges in multi-agent parallel scenarios. Interface displays session status per line (awaiting input/working/completed), previous reply summary and last interaction time, can directly peek-inline without context switching, also supports `/bg` or `claude --bg [task]` to start new tasks in background. Early users have already used it for concurrent task distribution, PR monitoring on schedule, fast context switching and other scenarios.

PRISM（作者Jinbin Bai等）针对离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的推理: PRISM (authors Jinbin Bai et al.) addresses the inference-time scaling problem for discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) by proposing a hierarchical decision architecture to replace the traditional brute-force Best-of-N search. Tested on LLaDA-8B-Instruct: GSM8K accuracy improved from 67.58% to 85.30%, MATH-500 from 26.40% to 42.80%; on Dream-7B-Instruct, HumanEval improved by 24.39pp, MBPP by 16.40pp. Compared to Best-of-N methods, PRISM achieves 2.9×–6.5× inference speedup.
Claw-Eval-Live提出面向Workflow Agent的动态评测ben: Claw-Eval-Live proposes a dynamic evaluation benchmark for Workflow Agents, with the core design separating a refreshable signal layer (updated with public workflow requirements) from reproducible timestamped snapshot releases. Current version contains 105 tasks, built on ClawHub Top-500 skills, covering enterprise services and local workspace repair scenarios. Evaluating 13 frontier models shows: the strongest model achieves only 66.7% pass rate, no model reaches 70%; HR, management, and multi-system business workflows remain persistent bottlenecks, while local workspace repair is relatively easier but far from saturated. The framework records execution traces, audit logs, and service states, scoring via deterministic checks + structured LLM judgment.

OpenAI详细介绍了为Windows版Codex构建安全沙箱的技术方案，核心实: OpenAI detailed the technical solution for building a security sandbox for Windows Codex, core implementations include: controlled filesystem access (restricting read/write directories), network isolation (prohibiting sandboxed processes from accessing external networks), process-level resource limits (CPU/memory/disk quotas). MiniMax Agent整体升级并更名Mavis（MiniMax as a J: MiniMax Agent undergoes major upgrade and rebrands as Mavis (MiniMax as a Jarvis), with core update being Agent Teams: desktop supports multi-Agent parallel work. Architecture designed with three role types—Leader (task decomposition and scheduling), Worker (execution), Verifier (adversarial quality gate)—driven by state machines rather than relying on model's free judgment. TokenPlan and Agent Plan merged into single subscription, CLI/API/Agent share Credits quota. MiniMax identifies four pain points of single Agent: mid-course stoppage, long task degradation, inability to respond instantly to users, unclear role division. Multi-Agent is a structural solution rather than Prompt orchestration.

NVIDIA宣布与Ineffable Intelligence合作共建大规模强化: NVIDIA announces partnership with Ineffable Intelligence to build large-scale reinforcement learning training infrastructure. Ineffable, founded by David Silver (AlphaGo chief architect), is London-headquartered. Collaboration starts with NVIDIA Grace Blackwell platform, with future exploration of Vera Rubin architecture. Nous Research提出Token-Superposition Train: Nous Research proposes Token-Superposition Training (TST), a plug-and-play pretraining acceleration method without modifying parallel strategies, optimizers, tokenizers, data, or model architecture. The core mechanism has two phases: (i) Superposition phase - merging multiple consecutive tokens into one bag, trained with multi-hot cross-entropy (MCE) objective; (ii) Recovery phase - returning to standard training. Validated at 270M and 600M parameter scales, confirmed effective on 3B and 10B A1B MoE models. At equivalent loss, pretraining time at 10B scale is reduced by 2.5x.
HuggingFace发布技术博客，详解如何在continuous batchi: HuggingFace publishes technical blog detailing how to achieve CPU-GPU async parallelism in continuous batching. Problem: In synchronous batching, CPU and GPU alternate waiting, GPU idle time accounts for 24%. Solution: Using CUDA non-default streams (compute/H2D/D2H three streams) to decouple CPU and GPU operations, cross-stream synchronization via CUDA events, dual-slot alternation to avoid race conditions, carry-over mechanism to pass cross-batch tokens. Real test on 8B model, batch 32, 8K token generation: Total time reduced from 300.6s to 234.5s (22% speedup), GPU activity rate increased from 76.0% to 99.4%.

Anthropic believes Chinese AI labs approach US level mainly relying on three factors: talent, exploitation of export control loopholes, large-scale distillation attacks (illegally extracting US company innovations). Scenario One: US maintains compute advantage, democratic nations lead AI governance, most likely reach cooperation with China on safety. Scenario Two: Controls loosen, China narrows gap or even surpasses. Anthropic expects transformative AI systems to arrive by 2028, current is a limited window for setting competitive conditions.

Unlike traditional RAG (retrieve relevant chunks → stuff into context), Nexus upgrades retrieval from passive querying to part of agent reasoning flow: supporting iterative search, multi-stage retrieval, dynamic memory updates. arXiv计算机科学版块主席Thomas Dietterich宣布新政策：如果提: arXiv Computer Science editorial board chair Thomas Dietterich announces new policy: if there is "irrefutable evidence" that authors did not check LLM-generated content (such as hallucinated citations, conversation traces with LLMs) in submitted papers, authors will be banned from submission for one year, with subsequent submissions requiring prior acceptance by formal peer-reviewed journals. 厦门大学与上海科技大学联合发表论文（ICML2026），提出MotionMAR框: Xiamen University and ShanghaiTech University jointly publish paper (ICML2026) proposing MotionMAR framework, reconstructing full-body motion from sparse observations (VR headset + controllers). Core design: temporal coarse-to-fine multi-scale autoregressive — first estimating global motion envelope, then progressively refining temporal details. Three components: Temporal Multi-scale VQ-VAE (separating global semantics from fine-grained jitter by temporal resolution), Motion Autoregressive Network (next-scale prediction, coarse scale locks global → fine scale restores details, Control Module injects sparse tracking priors), Motion Refinement Network (removing quantization artifacts, smoothing local kinematics).
浙江大学Weijie Wang等12位作者提出World-R1框架，通过强化学习: Zhejiang University Weijie Wang et al. 12 authors propose World-R1 framework, injecting 3D constraints into video generation models via reinforcement learning without modifying the underlying architecture. Core method: constructing dedicated pure-text dataset for world simulation, using Flow-GRPO optimization, with structural consistency feedback from pre-trained 3D foundation models and VLMs; introducing cycle-decoupled training strategy to balance rigid geometric consistency with dynamic scene fluency. Experiments show significant improvement in 3D consistency while maintaining original visual quality, bridging the gap between video generation and scalable world simulation.

腾讯混元大语言模型团队发布EvoEnv框架（arXiv 2605.14392），: Tencent Hunyuan large language model team releases EvoEnv framework (arXiv 2605.14392). Core idea: models not only generate training data but construct executable training environments (Python programs that can sample instances, compute reference answers, score responses). Key theoretical foundation is solve-verify asymmetry - verification is easy but solving is hard in the environment (e.g., dynamic programming, graph traversal, planted subset-sum), making reward signals remain effective as models strengthen. Method: starting from 10 seed environments, admitted after staged verification, semantic self-review, difficulty calibration, and novelty checking. On Qwen3-4B-Thinking, EvoEnv reduces average error rate across 7 reasoning benchmarks from 33.8% to 25.4%, surpassing fixed public data RLVR and handcrafted environment RLVR.

MIT、UMD、UND、UCF联合提出Pedagogical RL，核心洞察是：: MIT, UMD, UND, and UCF jointly propose Pedagogical RL. Core insight: existing on-policy RL (like GRPO) and on-policy self-distillation rely on privileged information (like answer keys) to evaluate rollouts but don't use this information to find good rollouts — if the model cannot accidentally encounter successful trajectories, RL stagnates. Pedagogical RL trains a self-teacher with privileged context, using spike-aware pedagogy reward that simultaneously requires trajectories to be correct and learnable at every step for the student, then transfers knowledge to the student via surprisal-gated imitation. On Llama-3.2-3B's MATH hard subset, MATH domain improves over GRPO by over 12%, AIME 2020-2024 achieves 22.5% Pass@4 (relative improvement over 40%). On Qwen3-4B reasoning regression tasks, achieves optimal performance with 2-3x fewer rollouts. Ablation experiments show product-form pedagogy reward outperforms additive teacher objective by approximately 9%.
Nadav Timor、Ravid Shwartz-Ziv、Micah Gold: Paper 'On Training in Imagination' by Nadav Timor, Ravid Shwartz-Ziv, Micah Goldblum, Yann LeCun, and David Harel quantifies how dynamics model and reward model errors affect policy optimization in model-based RL: (1) Models should have low Lipschitz constants so small input changes only produce small output changes, tightening error bounds of imagined rollouts; (2) Given finite budget, optimal allocation between dynamics samples and reward samples depends on which error source decreases faster — reward models grow much faster with data than dynamics models (predicting scalar rewards is simpler than predicting entire future states); (3) In some cases, large amounts of cheap noisy reward labels outperform small amounts of expensive precise labels (zero-mean noise keeps gradients unbiased), but biased rewards cause policy gradient bias that cannot be fixed.
香港中文大学与浙江大学的论文\"Contextual Agentic Memor: Paper 'Contextual Agentic Memory is a Memo, Not True Memory' from CUHK and Zhejiang University points out that current Agent memory systems (vector stores, RAG, scratchpads, context window management) implement lookup, not memory. Equating lookup with memory is a category error: retrieval generalizes by similarity to stored cases, while weight memory applies abstract rules to inputs never seen before. Confusing the two leads to Agents endlessly accumulating notes but never developing expertise, facing insurmountable generalization ceilings on combinatorial novel tasks, and structural vulnerability to persistent memory poisoning attacks. The research draws on the neuroscientific Complementary Learning Systems theory, noting that biological intelligence solved this problem through pairing fast hippocampal sample storage with slow neocortical weight consolidation, while current AI Agents have only implemented the first half.
美团技术团队论文\"U-Mind\"被CVPR 2026接收。U-Mind是首个: Meituan technical team's paper 'U-Mind' accepted by CVPR 2026. U-Mind is the first unified high-intelligence multimodal dialogue system supporting real-time generation, jointly modeling language, speech, action, and video in a single interaction loop. Core implementation is the Unified Alignment and Reasoning Framework, enhancing cross-modal synchronization through segment-wise alignment strategy and maintaining reasoning ability through Rehearsal-Driven Learning. Inference stage adopts text-first decoding, performing internal chain-of-thought planning first then cross-modal synchronous generation, with real-time video rendering based on pose and speech. Meituan technical team has published 10 papers at CVPR 2025 and ICLR 2025.
京东与中科院信工所三篇后训练论文。RLSD（Self-Distilled RLV: Three post-training papers from JD and CAS IA. RLSD (Self-Distilled RLVR) points out that relying solely on privileged teacher signals leads to severe information leakage and training instability; proposes using self-distillation to obtain token-level policy differences (determining update magnitude), while using RLVR environment feedback to determine update direction. NPO (Near-Future Policy Optimization) proposes sampling auxiliary trajectories from later checkpoints in the same training run (stronger than current policy, closer than external sources); AutoNPO automatically triggers intervention, improving Qwen3-VL-8B from 57.88 to 63.15. CoPD (Co-Evolving Policy Distillation) enables multiple experts to train in parallel and serve as mutual teachers for bidirectional distillation, achieving all-in-one integration of text/image/video reasoning capabilities, surpassing mixed RLVR and domain experts.
耶鲁大学论文发表于Nature。MOSAIC（Multiple Optimize: Yale University paper published in Nature. MOSAIC (Multiple Optimized Specialists for AI-assisted Chemical Prediction) is based on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct architecture, training 2,498 specialized expert models in Voronoi-clustered chemical space, leveraging collective knowledge from millions of reaction protocols to generate reproducible, executable experimental plans with confidence indicators. Experimental validation covers over 35 novel compounds across drug, material, pesticide, and cosmetics domains, with overall success rate of 71%. Notably, MOSAIC can also discover new reaction methods not present in expert training data.
Sebastian Raschka发文分析近期开源LLM的架构创新，核心主题是长: Sebastian Raschka publishes analysis of recent open-source LLM architectural innovations, core theme being long-context efficiency optimization. Gemma 4 E2B/E4B introduces cross-layer KV sharing (saving approximately half of KV cache) and per-layer embeddings (PLE) to increase parameter capacity without expanding main computation. Laguna XS.2 (Poolside's first release) adopts layer-wise attention budgets, allocating fewer query heads to global attention layers to reduce costs. ZAYA1-8B (Zyphra, trained on AMD GPUs) uses Compressed Convolutional Attention (CCA), executing attention directly in compressed latent space, simultaneously reducing KV cache and attention FLOPs. DeepSeek V4 introduces mHC (manifold-constrained hyper-connectivity) expanding single residual stream into multiple parallel residual streams, along with CSA/HCA hybrid compressed attention; 1M context inference requires only 10% of DeepSeek V3.2's KV cache and 27% FLOPs.

挑战了当前过度依赖on-policy学习的范式，指出瓶颈不在如何从奖励更新，而在: Challenges current paradigm of over-reliance on on-policy learning, pointing out that the bottleneck is not how to update from rewards, but how to find trajectories worth learning.

OpenAI宣布其通用推理模型解决了平面单位距离问题（planar unit d: OpenAI announces its general reasoning model solved the planar unit distance problem, posed by mathematician Paul Erdős in 1946, a classic open problem in combinatorial geometry. For nearly 80 years, the mathematical community believed optimal solutions roughly follow square grid structures. The OpenAI model discovered a completely new construction family that outperforms square grids, overturning this assumption. OpenAI claims this is the first time AI independently solved a core open problem in mathematics. Sam Altman calls it an important milestone but expresses complex feelings about AI's impact on mathematical understanding. Fields Medal recipient Timothy Gowers reminded fellow mathematicians to "hold on tight" when sharing it.
阿里千问团队发布Qwen3.7-Max，定位\"面向智能体时代的新一代旗舰模型\: Alibaba Qwen team releases Qwen3.7-Max, positioned as "next-generation flagship model for the agent era." For coding agents: SWE-Pro 60.6, SWE-Verified 80.4 (comparable to Opus-4.6 Max's 80.8), Terminal Bench 2.0-Terminus 69.7 surpassing DeepSeek-V4-Pro Max's 67.9. For general agents: MCP-Mark 60.8, MCP-Atlas 76.4, Skillbench 59.2 all lead. For reasoning: GPQA Diamond 92.4 (surpassing Opus-4.6's 91.3), HLE 41.4, HMMT 2026 Feb 97.1. Major highlight: In a 35-hour continuous autonomous GPU kernel optimization experiment, the model completed 1158 tool calls, achieving 10.0x speedup on SGLang Extend Attention kernel on an unseen hardware platform (T-Head Zhenwu M890 PPU), significantly outperforming GLM 5.1 (7.3x), Kimi K2.6 (5.0x), DeepSeek V4 Pro (3.3x). Model supports cross-framework generalization for multiple agent frameworks including Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code, to be served via Alibaba Cloud Bailian API soon.
Stability AI发布Stable Audio 3.0模型家族，采用全新语: Stability AI releases Stable Audio 3.0 model family with new semantic-acoustic autoencoder architecture. Three open-weight versions: 3.0 Small SFX (sound effects), 3.0 Small (up to 2 minutes of complete music, reportedly the only model supporting on-device full composition), 3.0 Medium and 3.0 Large (generating over 6 minutes of music). Supports variable-length generation (second-level precision), audio repair (single/multi-segment editing, causal continuation) and LoRa fine-tuning (first audio LoRa training documentation released). All models trained on fully licensed data; users own output copyright and can commercialize under Stability AI Community License. Partnerships established with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group. 3.0 Small and Medium weights available for download on HuggingFace, Large via API.

AI division capex surged from $12.7 billion for full-year 2025 to $7.7 billion in Q1 2026 alone (annualized ~$308 billion). Grok AI has 117 million monthly active users (~one-fifth of X+Grok's 550 million total MAU). Filing reveals up to $40 billion cloud service agreement signed with Anthropic; next-generation Grok will scale to "trillions of parameters". Colossus and Colossus II data centers combined provide ~1GW of compute. SpaceX plans to deploy orbital AI computing satellites as early as 2028, stating "AI's future will be determined by who controls the physical stack." Potential valuation $1.75 trillion.
VERL-Omni团队发布通用强化学习后训练框架，面向多模态生成模型。该框架基于: VERL-Omni team releases general RL post-training framework for multimodal generative models. Framework built on VERL and vLLM-Omni, supporting unified training for vision, language, audio and other multimodal tasks. vLLM-Omni handles step-wise continuous batching for multimodal rollout and embedding caching; vLLM also serves as VLM-as-judge/OCR reward model, executing overlapping with rollout and training. In Qwen-Image OCR demo, moving reward to separate GPU reduces per-step wall-clock time by ~14%. FlowGRPO/MixGRPO/GRPO-Guard training recipes released for Qwen-Image; BAGEL and Qwen3-Omni-Thinker PRs ready.
Google推出Gemini for Science，包含三大实验性工具：Hyp: Google launches Gemini for Science with three experimental tools: Hypothesis Generation (based on Co-Scientist, generating and validating hypotheses through multi-agent "idea tournament" with clickable citations), Computational Discovery (based on AlphaEvolve and ERA, parallel generation and evaluation of thousands of code variants to accelerate computational experiments), Literature Insights (based on NotebookLM, structuring literature search results into comparable tables). Also releases Science Skills toolkit integrating 30+ life science databases (UniProt, AlphaFold, AlphaGenome, etc.), reducing structural bioinformatics and genome analysis from hours to minutes on Antigravity platform. ERA and Co-Scientist papers published in Nature. Partnerships with 100+ institutions (including Stanford, Imperial College London, The Crick Institute), currently open for registration as trusted tester at labs.google/science.

Paired with self-developed interconnect chip ICN Switch 1.0 (25.6Tbps throughput), 128 AI chips tightly coupled in single cabinet, P2P latency under 150ns, cabinet bandwidth at Pb/s level, comparable to "128 GPUs forming one computer." Available on Alibaba Cloud Bailian, supporting Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi and other mainstream models. Self-developed T-Head SAIL software stack provides end-to-end support. Zhenwu series chips have shipped 560,000 units cumulatively, serving 400+ customers across 20+ industries. More powerful Zhenwu V900 and J900 planned for release in next two years.

中国科学技术大学等机构研究团队发表论文\"Learning to Foresee: USTC Research Team Publishes Paper "Learning to Foresee", Revealing Why On-Policy Distillation (OPD) Is Efficient. Research Finds OPD's Efficiency Stemming from "Foresight" Capability: Establishing Stable Update Trajectory Toward Final Model Early in Training. This Foresight Manifests at Two Levels - Module Allocation Level, OPD Identifies Low Marginal Utility Regions and Concentrates Updates on Critical Reasoning Modules; Update Direction Level, OPD Shows Stronger Low-Rank Concentration, Its Dominant Subspace Aligned with Final Update Subspace Early in Training. Based on These Findings, Team Proposes EffOPD Method, Adaptively Selecting Extrapolation Step Size Along Current Update Direction, Achieving Average 3x Training Acceleration Without Additional Trainable Modules or Complex Hyperparameter Tuning While Maintaining Final Performance.
谢赛宁团队发布RAEv2（Improved Baselines with Rep: Xie Saining Team Releases RAE v2 (Improved Baselines with Representation Autoencoders), Systematically Improving Representation Autoencoder (RAE) Design. Research Uncovers Three Key Insights: Defining Representation as Sum of Encoder's Last k Layers Instead of Last Layer Alone Significantly Improves Reconstruction Quality; RAE and REPA (Representation Alignment) Have Complementary Mechanisms and Can Be Used Together; Simple Reparameterization of DiT Output Achieves "Free" Guidance Without Additional Model Training. RAE v2 Achieves gFID 1.06 in Only 80 Epochs on ImageNet-256, Over 10x Faster Convergence Than Original RAE. Achieves FDr^k 2.17 in 80 Epochs, Surpassing Previous Best Score of 3.26 in 800 Epochs. Method Also Validates Consistent Improvements in Text-to-Image Generation and Navigation World Models.
论文提出PlexRL，一种面向RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）训练的集群级运行时系: Paper Proposes PlexRL, a Cluster-Level Runtime System for RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) Training. Authors Point Out RLVR Training Inefficiency Is Structural: Long-tail Rollout, Tool Calling Blockage and Asymmetric Resource Demands Between Rollout and Training Cannot Be Eliminated Within Individual Tasks. But Idle Periods Across Different Tasks Show Anti-correlation, Thus Exploitable at Cluster Level. PlexRL Manages Model Deployment, State Transition and Function-Level Scheduling Centrally, Slices LLM Execution Across Tasks Under Strict Affinity Constraints, Filling Idle Periods Without Expensive Model Migration. Experiments Show PlexRL Effectively Improves Cluster Capacity, User GPU Hour Cost Reduced by Up to 37.58% While Maintaining Algorithm Flexibility.

Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion针对传统LLM逐token自回归生: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion addresses the memory bandwidth bottleneck of traditional LLM token-by-token autoregressive generation by unifying three decoding modes in a single architecture: AR preserves traditional serial generation; Diffusion drafts in 32-token blocks in parallel followed by multi-step iterative refinement; Self-Speculation uses diffusion for parallel drafting and AR causal verification, producing outputs identical to pure AR (no quality loss). The model continues pretraining on AR foundation with joint AR-diffusion objective (1.3T tokens pretraining + 45B tokens SFT, based on Nemotron dataset), with block-wise attention compatible with KV cache. Family includes 3B/8B/14B text models and 8B vision-language model, all available in base and instruct versions. This law targets systematically reducing time constants (Tao τ), compressing signal propagation delay and improving transistor density through innovative technologies like logic folding. Huawei has successfully designed and mass produced 381 chips over the past six years, expecting to achieve 1.4nm equivalent transistor density for high-end chips by 2031 based on this law. He Tingbo announced Huawei will release new Kirin mobile chip this fall, fully utilizing logic folding technology. SaaS-Bench reveals four structural failures of Agents: pass rate decreases as task length increases, one step error causes chain failures, no post-execution result verification, massive score variance across multiple runs of same task (Claude Sonnet 4.6 same task three runs scored from 0.00 to 0.68).
中科大马鑫等人在ICML 2026发表论文\"More Edits, More: USTC's Ma Xin et al. publish "More Edits, More Stable" at ICML 2026, revealing the counter-intuitive "more editing, more stability" phenomenon in Lifelong Model Editing. Research focuses on Lifelong Normalization (LN), finding LN removal causes immediate performance collapse while early edits actually facilitate subsequent edit success. The paper provides LN's first theoretical explanation, proving its combination with ridge regression yields asymptotically orthogonal and bounded-norm parameter updates, directly mitigating catastrophic forgetting and model collapse. Based on this, StableEdit is proposed, reinforcing stability cycles through explicit warmup and full whitening.
方振等人联合提出Flow-OPD，将LLM后训练中的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）引入F: Fang Zhen et al. jointly propose Flow-OPD, bringing online policy distillation (OPD) from LLM post-training to Flow Matching text-to-image models. The method uses a two-stage strategy: first fine-tuning domain-specialized teacher models with single-reward GRPO, then distilling multiple teachers' expertise into a single student model through online sampling, task-routing annotation, and trajectory-level dense supervision. Manifold Anchoring Regularization (MAR) is introduced, using task-agnostic teachers for full-data supervision to mitigate aesthetic degradation common in pure RL alignment. Based on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, Flow-OPD boosts GenEval from 63 to 92, OCR accuracy from 59 to 94, ~10 points overall improvement over vanilla GRPO, with an emergent "student surpasses teacher" effect.

The engine uses chunk-level LoD with streaming scheduling, enabling second-level loading for billion-point scenes with initial screen entry within 10 seconds; offers effect-priority, performance-priority, and extreme performance rendering modes; supports physics collision body generation and cloud hybrid rendering. MIT licensed, supporting ply/spz/sog/splat formats, suitable for SDK integration and secondary development.

The dataset contains 58,445 samples covering 40 action types, 30 participants, two indoor environments, encompassing 7 modalities (vision, depth, pose, audio, IMU, mmWave, etc.). The team proposes three benchmark tasks: Human Action Recognition (HAR, 76.52% avg accuracy), Human Action Understanding (HAU, 40.76%), and Human Action Reasoning (HARn, 70.25%), with 6 evaluation subtasks. Research indicates current large vision-language models perform poorly on non-RGB modalities, primarily due to lack of large-scale data-description pairing resources.

EAGLE团队、vLLM团队和TorchSpec团队联合发布EAGLE 3.1推: The EAGLE team, vLLM team, and TorchSpec team jointly released EAGLE 3.1 speculative decoding scheme. The core improvement solves the "attention drift" problem—where the draft model's attention progressively deviates from the sink token as speculation depth increases. EAGLE 3.1 introduces FC normalization and post-norm hidden-state feedback for architectural improvements, doubling the acceptance length compared to EAGLE 3 in long-context scenarios. Benchmark based on Kimi K2.6 shows 2.03× throughput improvement per user output at concurrency 1, with 1.66× acceleration at concurrency 16. The scheme has been merged into vLLM main branch, to be officially released in v0.22.0, with the Kimi K2.6 EAGLE 3.1 draft model already open-sourced.

卡内基梅隆大学Sangyun Lee等人发表论文\"Language Model: Carnegie Mellon University's Sangyun Lee et al. published the paper "Language Models Need Sleep", proposing a sleep-like consolidation mechanism: the model periodically converts recent context into persistent fast weights, then clears the KV cache. During "sleep", the model performs N offline recurrent traversals on accumulated context, updating fast weights of SSM blocks through learned local rules. Inference-time extra computation is shifted to the sleep phase, maintaining unchanged prediction latency during wake phase. Experiments show increasing sleep iterations N improves performance, with the largest gains on samples requiring deeper reasoning, while regular Transformers and SSM-Attention hybrid models fail on these tasks.
HuggingFace技术博客披露其TRL库中的Delta Weight Syn: HuggingFace technical blog disclosed the Delta Weight Sync scheme in their TRL library, solving the weight synchronization bottleneck in asynchronous RL training. Core discovery: between adjacent RL optimization steps, approximately 99% of bf16 weights are bit-identical (worst case no lower than 98%), therefore only changed sparse deltas need to be transmitted. On Qwen3-0.6B, transmission per step reduced from 1.2 GB to 20-35 MB (~130× reduction). Architecturally, trainer and vLLM inference server exchange weights via HF Bucket (based on Xet content-addressed storage), without requiring shared clusters, RDMA, or VPN. Measurements show fully decoupled training: trainer on a single GPU machine, vLLM running in HF Space, with only 1.1 second pause per sync inference. For Llama-3.1-405B, estimated delta per step is approximately 6 GB (vs 810 GB for full sync). Theoretical basis from PULSE paper (Mihai & Belilovsky, 2026), code merged into TRL PR #5417.
SemiAnalysis发布深度分析文章，指出当前GPU普遍存在理论峰值算力与实: SemiAnalysis published an in-depth analysis article, pointing out that current GPUs generally suffer from a serious mismatch between theoretical peak compute and actual throughput. Hand-tuned CUDA kernels almost cannot bridge this gap at scale, while auto-generated CUDA kernels can surpass hand-optimized performance. The article quotes Mohamed Abdelfattah, co-founder and CSO of Makora, and relates to his interview video with Kimbo Chen "How Makora Generates CUDA Kernels That Beat Hand-Tuned Code".

Artificial Analysis与IBM Research联合发布ITBe: Artificial Analysis and IBM Research jointly released ITBench-AA, the first benchmark evaluating enterprise IT agents, with initial focus on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) tasks. The benchmark contains 59 Kubernetes incident diagnosis tasks: models need to identify root cause entities from alerts, logs, distributed tracing, metrics, and application topology. Claude Opus 4.7 leads with 47%, GPT-5.5 at 46%, Qwen3.7 Max at 42%, with all frontier models below 50%, making it one of the most unsaturated agent benchmarks currently. Among open-weight models, GLM-5.1 leads at 40%, close to Gemini 3.5 Flash. Turn count does not correlate with accuracy: GPT-5.5 averages 31 turns to reach 46%, while Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview averages 83 turns for only 30%—excessive investigation introduces false positives.
Harvey联合Artificial Analysis发布LAB（Legal A: Harvey jointly released with Artificial Analysis LAB (Legal Agent Benchmark), the first open-source evaluation benchmark for legal agents. Under strict all-pass criteria, Claude Opus 4.7 leads with 7.1% pass rate, Sonnet 4.6 at 5.4%, Opus 4.6 at 4.2%, GPT-5.5 at 2.1%, and Gemini 3.5 Flash at 0.8%—frontier models all below 10% completion rate on end-to-end legal tasks. Model rankings vary across different legal domains: Opus 4.7 is strongest in corporate M&A, GPT-5.5 leads in regulatory research, Sonnet 4.6 performs best in privacy and tax, exhibiting "jagged intelligence" characteristics. The highest-scoring model costs approximately $50 and has approximately 22 minutes latency per task. Behavioral analysis found that agent self-correction (revise-after-check) improves scores by 1.5 points, the strongest positive behavioral signal.

Key technologies include gradient bridging co-training, vision-aligned action tokenizer, action space supervision, and DMuon optimizer. Model weights, training code, and paper all open-sourced.

Oura发布第五代智能戒指Ring 5，较上一代体积缩小40%，续航6-9天（上: Oura releases fifth-generation smart ring Ring 5, 40% smaller than previous generation, 6-9 day battery life (vs 5-8 days), starting at $399. New "Health Radar" feature includes blood pressure signal monitoring and nighttime breath analysis. Blood pressure feature tracks blood pressure trends through cardiovascular patterns during sleep, alerting when nighttime BP doesn't naturally decline. Simultaneously launches AI-driven medical consultation through partnership with Counsel Health, connecting licensed physicians within the app. Also adds GLP-1 medication tracking, real-time exercise data, brain health research, and more. Ring 5 launches a year and a half earlier than previous generation, facing pressure from subscription-free competitors like RingConn Gen 3.
Visa对AI编码平台Replit进行战略投资，金额未披露。双方正在探索将Vis: Visa makes strategic investment in AI coding platform Replit; amount undisclosed. Both parties are exploring integrating Visa's Intelligent Commerce payment products and Trusted Agent Protocol (AI Agent secure identity verification protocol) into Replit platform, enabling AI Agents built by developers to complete payment transactions directly within the platform. Over 1,000 Visa employees already use Replit internally for prototyping. Simultaneously, Replit launches self-serve enterprise version; enterprises can sign contracts up to $200,000 online with SSO, audit logs, and advanced permission management. Replit completed $400 million Series D in March this year at $9 billion valuation, a 3x increase from $3 billion in September last year within 6 months.
Meta支持的Biohub发布新一代Evolutionary Scale Mod: Meta-backed Biohub releases new generation Evolutionary Scale Models (ESM), containing three components: protein language model ESMC (trained on 2.8 billion protein sequences), structure prediction model ESMFold2, and ESM Atlas encompassing 680 million sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures. ESMFold2 correctly predicts 55% of antibody-antigen complexes on Foldbench, predicting 71% of protein-protein interaction complexes from single sequences. On clinically relevant targets (EGFR, PD-L1, CTLA-4, etc.), ESMFold2-designed protein binders validated in lab: nanobody scFv binding affinity to PD-L1 reaches 4.3 nM. With increased compute scale, mini-binder success rate rises from 54% to 70%, scFv from 12% to 21%. Cryo-EM validation shows RMSD of only 1.204 Å between designed and predicted structures. All models open-sourced under MIT license.
Caijun Xu等人在arXiv发表论文DenoiseRL，提出一种不依赖强教: Caijun Xu et al. publish paper DenoiseRL on arXiv, proposing a reinforcement learning framework that doesn't rely on strong teacher models or carefully curated difficult datasets. DenoiseRL learns directly from weak models' erroneous reasoning chains, turning mistakes into improvement opportunities. On competitive math and general reasoning benchmarks, DenoiseRL consistently outperforms strong on-policy RL baselines, and as training difficulty increases, models exhibit stronger self-correction behavior.
浙江大学Ningyu Zhang等人在arXiv发表论文MemTrace，首次系: Ningyu Zhang et al. from Zhejiang University publish MemTrace on arXiv, the first systematic study of error tracing and attribution in LLM memory systems. The framework transforms memory pipelines into executable memory evolution graphs, supporting fine-grained tracing of operation-level information flow. Constructs MemTraceBench benchmark covering four representative memory systems: Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS. Analysis finds memory failures are systemic, rooted in operation-level issues like information loss and retrieval misalignment. Uses attribution signals to guide downstream prompt optimization, establishing closed-loop self-correction systems with end-task performance improvements up to 7.62%.
TechCrunch深度分析指出，递归自我改进（RSI）正取代AGI成为AI行业: TechCrunch in-depth analysis points out that Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) is replacing AGI as AI industry's new buzzword. Richard Socher's Recursive Superintelligence, Andrej Karpathy's Auto-Research project, and Sara Hooker's Adaption AutoScientist all target RSI. Google CEO Sundar Pichai admits "we're far from it." METR's Ajeya Cotra divides RSI path into three stages: adequacy (research output without humans), parity (AI matching humans), supremacy (AI surpassing human-machine collaboration), expecting adequacy to be achieved in 1-2 years, with supremacy potentially following within 1 year once parity is reached. CSET's Helen Toner points out that current so-called RSI "is merely doing as much AI research with AI as possible," rather than the classic definition of a closed loop "without human involvement."
Makoto Shing和Takuya Akiba（Sakana AI）发表论文: Makoto Shing and Takuya Akiba (Sakana AI) publish paper DiffusionBlocks, reinterpreting block-wise neural network training as denoising operations in continuous-time diffusion processes. By dividing networks into independently trainable blocks and optimizing noise level allocation, achieves memory reduction proportional to number of blocks while surpassing traditional end-to-end backpropagation on image generation and language modeling tasks. Paper accepted by ICML 2025 TTODLer-FM Workshop.
SemiAnalysis分析师在X平台评论codex在应用浏览器UX（用户界面）: SemiAnalysis analyst comments on X platform about codex's performance in applying browser UX (user interface) direction, considering it promising for web development scenarios. The analysis points out codex's browser integration direction is correct, but needs to wait for codex model itself to reach sufficient performance on web development tasks to realize full value. Current codex still has limitations on complex web development tasks.
SemiAnalysis发布AI Agent使用数据分析：63%的会话完全不使用: SemiAnalysis releases AI Agent usage data analysis: 63% of sessions use no sub-agents at all, 25.9% use 1-5 parallel sub-agents, only 9.8% of sessions use more than 5 parallel sub-agents. Data based on anonymous usage statistics. SemiAnalysis points out complex Agent architecture has not yet become the mainstream usage pattern.
Agility Robotics发文系统分析家庭环境对人形机器人的三大障碍。能力: Agility Robotics publishes systematic analysis of three major barriers for humanoid robots in home environments. Capability barrier: robotics lacks an "internet text data pool" equivalent to LLM—motion control requires physical-dimensional data including force, lighting, joint degrees of freedom, speed, safety, and contact dynamics, with extremely high data collection costs. Cost barrier: humanoid robot prices must drop to "family car" levels to enter homes, currently far exceeding this level, so the company prioritizes industrial warehouse scenarios (tote handling, palletizing, etc.). Safety barrier: home scenarios require near 100% reliability, versus 95% acceptable for industrial scenarios. Agility participated in developing ISO 25785-1 standard, establishing formal HARA (Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment) for bipedal robots. Company path: industrial scenarios → controlled environments → ultimately entering homes.

Its first chip MX1 connects directly to the CPU via CXL (Compute Express Link), moving data preprocessing, KV cache management, and caching tasks that originally ran on the CPU directly into the memory module, eliminating the need to shuttle between CPU/GPU/memory. LLM自我提升常用best-of-N采样或树搜索找更好的答案，但所有候选都来自模: LLMs self-improvement commonly uses best-of-N sampling or tree search to find better answers, but all candidates come from the model continuing to write on its own, only exploring within its familiar output space and unable to break out. BES (from Harvard's Sham M. Kakade, Yilun Du team) adds two new mechanisms: forward uses evolutionary operators to recombine segments from multiple different paths, generating candidates that single continuations cannot produce; backward recursively decomposes goals into verifiable subgoals, providing dense feedback to the search process. Key results: on MuSiQue multi-hop reasoning tasks, improving Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct accuracy from 4.0% to 7.0% (under the same conditions, GRPO actually degrades performance, Tree-GRPO has almost no improvement); surpassing OpenEvolve, GEPA, ShinkaEvolve and other open-source evolutionary frameworks on circle packing and Heilbronn convex optimization tasks.
长上下文推理时KV缓存占用大量显存。把KV从16-bit压到2-bit可省约87: Long-context reasoning consumes significant GPU memory with KV cache. Compressing KV from 16-bit to 2-bit saves approximately 87.5% of memory, but traditional Hadamard rotation quantization schemes collapse at INT2 precision—because the rotation method doesn't match how attention actually works. OSCAR (from TogetherAI research scientist Zhongzhu Zhou et al.) analyzes attention's covariance structure offline, aligning the rotation matrix with the attention mechanism, with a self-developed INT2 kernel that can directly integrate with SGLang and vLLM. Results: Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and Qwen3-8B show accuracy gaps of only 3.78 and 1.42 points respectively compared to BF16 (naive INT2 schemes are close to 0); extending to GLM-4.7 (358B parameters) remains on par with BF16; long-context RULER-NIAH test reaches 32k tokens.
LLM对高频实体（如OpenAI、Sam Altman这类频繁出现的对象）记忆扎: LLMs have solid memory for high-frequency entities (like OpenAI, Sam Altman, objects that appear frequently), but easily confuse or hallucinate when encountering low-frequency entities (like Ma Jiaqi from TNT)—this phenomenon has long been attributed to 'training data absence'. A paper from CUHK by Hongyuan Adam Lu, Wai Lam et al. proves that text frequency itself is a key variable determining LLM performance, independent of whether it appears in the training set. Based on this, the paper provides three practical approaches: using LLMs to rewrite low-frequency expressions into synonymous high-frequency versions before input; curriculum learning from low to high frequency; automatically estimating text frequency through story completion. Validation scope: performance improvements observed across four task types—mathematical reasoning, machine translation, commonsense reasoning, and Agent tool calling—on the self-built TFPD dataset.
面壁智能联合清华大学和OpenBMB开源UltraData-SFT-2605数据: ModelBest, together with Tsinghua University and OpenBMB, open-sourced the UltraData-SFT-2605 dataset, containing 15 million training samples with 'deep thinking' processes, covering four domains: math, code, knowledge, and instruction following. Each sample provides both 'chain-of-thought reasoning' and 'direct answer' formats. The dataset has been used to train MiniCPM5-1B with complete validation.
Agent表现不只取决于模型本身，还取决于「harness」——模型与环境之间的: Agent performance depends not only on the model itself but also on the 'harness'—the intermediate layer between model and environment (how to observe, invoke tools, parse feedback, control trajectory). In strictly rule-based task environments, many failures actually stem from mismatches in this interface layer rather than insufficient model capability. Tianshi Xu et al. from Peking University propose Life-Harness: without modifying model weights or evaluation environments, evolve the harness from training trajectories, converting recurring interaction failures into four types of reusable interventions—environmental contracts, procedural skills, action grounding, and trajectory regulation—fixed for evaluation on unseen tasks. Results: 116 out of 126 configurations improved across 18 model backbones; harnesses evolved from Qwen3-4B-Instruct can directly transfer to the other 17 models.
AI安全研究员Neel Nanda指出，当前大多数对齐评估缺乏现实性，无法有效捕: AI safety researcher Neel Nanda points out that most current alignment evaluations lack realism and cannot effectively capture models that will actively deceive after deployment. Traditional evaluations can only demonstrate a model's deceptive capabilities through manual nudging, making it difficult to test whether it has an innate tendency to deceive. He mentions Google DeepMind is advancing two approaches: 'realistic honeypot evaluations,' placing Gemini in internal deployment scenarios with actual opportunities for sabotage to observe spontaneous behavior; and a tool called Gram, an alignment audit tool to assess the likelihood of AI agents engaging in destructive behavior during internal deployment. Any model under sufficient incentive could behave badly, and traditional benchmarks are insufficient to verify safety.
SemiAnalysis发文，把AI生产却未被GDP捕捉的价值称为「Dark O: SemiAnalysis published an article calling AI-produced value not captured by GDP 'Dark Output.' The article quotes Robert Solow's remark that 'you can see the computer age everywhere except in the productivity statistics' as an analogy to the current AI situation. Key reference: the 2013 GDP methodology revision incorporated R&D and intellectual property investment, catching up approximately $3.6 trillion in total output from the 1990s (close to 30% of 2000's full-year GDP); current tech Magnificent Seven market cap has reached 1.8 times Europe's total. Dark Output has two categories: substitution type (AI replacing human work, currently identifying approximately $1.5 trillion in tasks that existing AI can augment or automate) and creation type (AI doing work that was previously never done due to prohibitive costs). Typical example: basic will drafting has dropped from $400 to $150 over 30 years (annual decline of $0.5/5000 words—a 99% drop within a year directly vanishes from economic statistics. Legal services CPI wasn't included until 1987, and by September 2024 had accumulated a 4.6x increase, essentially becoming an employee cost index. Fed vice chair nominee Kevin Warsh warned in December 2025 that 'data is lagging, you have to bet.'
