NVIDIA与清华大学联合提出γ-World，一个支持多智能体（多玩家）的生成式: NVIDIA and Tsinghua University jointly propose γ-World, a generative world model supporting multi-agent (multi-player) interactions. Core innovations include: Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding (parameter-free 3D RoPE extension based on regular simplex, achieving permutation-symmetric agent identity encoding) and Sparse Hub Attention (mediating cross-agent communication through learnable hub tokens, reducing attention cost from quadratic to linear). The model distills bidirectional multi-agent teachers into chunk causal student models, supporting KV cache streaming inference, achieving real-time 24 FPS. Experiments show γ-World can generalize from 2-player to 4-player interactions without additional training.
Yann LeCun、David Klindt、Randall Balestri: Yann LeCun, David Klindt, and Randall Balestriero jointly publish theoretical work. World models should learn the "true structure" of the world rather than surface pixels, but JEPA previously only had empirical results without theoretical guarantees. The paper proves: only when the latent variable distribution is Gaussian can LeJEPA recover the true underlying structure of the world from nonlinear pixel-level observations; all other non-Gaussian distributions cannot provide the same guarantee. Experiments cover latent variables from 2D to 1024 dimensions, including distribution ablation and pixel-level robot control verification.
香港中文大学、马克斯普朗克研究所等机构联合提出Pion优化器。与Adam/Muo: CUHK, Max Planck Institute and other institutions jointly propose Pion optimizer. Unlike additive optimizers like Adam/Muon, Pion updates weight matrices through left-right orthogonal transformations, maintaining singular values throughout training, achieving an update mechanism of "adjusting geometric structure while fixing spectral norm". Follow-up work Rethinking Muon Beyond Pretraining further reveals Muon's uniform spectral whitening failure modes in VLA and RLVR scenarios, proposing high-pass NS iteration as an alternative. Pion achieves 100% success rate on LIBERO VLA tasks (Muon 97%, AdamW 32.2%); in RLVR post-training, Muon collapses to zero while Pion stably outperforms AdamW.
俄勒冈州立/UCSD/Amazon AGI/宾州州立联合提出MetaAgent-: Oregon State/UCSD/Amazon AGI/Penn State jointly propose MetaAgent-X, addressing the "frozen executor ceiling" problem in automatic multi-agent systems (MAS) where existing methods only optimize the design layer or only do test-time search. MetaAgent-X achieves structured rollout generation and precise credit assignment through Executor Designer Hierarchical Rollout, and decoupled scalable training through Stagewise Co-evolution. On Qwen3-4B and 8B base models, it improves up to 21.7% over 6 automatic MAS baselines including AFlow/ADAS/ScoreFlow/MaAS/AFM. SFT cold start is based on 3K Designer + 8K Executor DeepSeek-V3.2 trajectories; RL stage mixes Polaris-Dataset-53K/APPS/CodeContests training.

Anastasia Kotelnikova等人评估LLM teams在ChGK问: Anastasia Kotelnikova et al. evaluate LLM teams on the ChGK quiz game, which requires indirect reasoning and cultural knowledge. Using 572 questions released in 2025, they compare three strategies: Voting, Silent Team, and Talkative Team. Experiments with six open-source models show team strategies boosting accuracy by up to 20 percentage points, with the best team achieving 44.23%, approaching human team levels. Analysis reveals strong inter-model disagreement predicts low accuracy, but explanatory communication can mitigate the decline. The study concludes LLM teams primarily function as answer selection and error filtering mechanisms rather than novel solution generators.
Liwei Kang、Yee Whye Teh和Wee Sun Lee发现LLM: Liwei Kang, Yee Whye Teh, and Wee Sun Lee discover that as LLM reasoning trajectories form linearized search trees, raw search history is insufficient to reliably outperform heuristic search observing only local states. The reason is that backtracking does not explicitly mark which earlier state was returned to. By adding parent pointers to explicitly represent the linearized tree structure (LinTree), they simultaneously improve task performance and search efficiency across Blocks World, Grid Navigation, and Sokoban environments. Results indicate search history is most useful when tree structure is made explicit.
Yiming Ren等人提出S2L-PO（Small-to-Large Poli: Yiming Ren et al. propose S2L-PO (Small-to-Large Policy Optimization), leveraging same-family small models as natural explorers to train large models. They discover that small models achieve higher pass@k as sampling increases, with their diversity exhibiting temporal correlation while maintaining logical consistency, superior to token-level random noise. Through progressive annealing strategy transitioning from small model offline rollouts to the large model's own sampling, they avoid mid-stage performance degradation caused by small model capacity limitations. On AIME 24, using a 1.7B model to guide an 8B model achieves +8.8% accuracy improvement while reducing rollout computation.
DeepPrinciple提出Materials Property Axiom（: DeepPrinciple proposes Materials Property Axiom (MPA), adapting LLM's three-stage training paradigm (pretraining→alignment→post-training) for materials property prediction. Pretraining is based on approximately 64 million 3D self-supervised optimized material geometries. The intermediate stage selects auxiliary data based on physical relevance to target properties, with post-training fine-tuned for specific experimental endpoints. Across 40 experimental properties, MAE is reduced by 10% on average, with a maximum reduction of 51% in individual OOD tasks. The greatest improvements occur when intermediate training signals align with the physical mechanisms of target properties.
Shraman Pal和Can Li提出DisjunctiveNet，通过可微分: Shraman Pal and Can Li propose DisjunctiveNet, enforcing hard mixed-integer linear constraints in neural networks through differentiable convex optimization layers. The method represents logical rules as disjunctive constraints, deriving convex hull forms through hierarchical convex relaxation, generating linear constraints embeddable as differentiable optimization layers and achieving precise rule satisfaction. On real datasets, it achieves perfect rule satisfaction and strong predictive performance, overcoming limitations of existing methods that can only approximately satisfy constraints.
